newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh unit gets $12.6 mln order.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh unit gets $12.6 mln order.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said Thursday its Pierce Manufacturing Inc has received a $12.6 million contract for 31 new fire trucks, the largest order Pierce has received from a U.S. customer in its 84-year history.

The order is a part of a cost-saving reorganization of Richmond, Virginia's fire department, based on multipurpose "quint" fire trucks performing a variety of pumping and aerial fire fighting functions at the same time, Oshkosh said.
As part of the contract, Pierce will provide service for 15 years, the company said.
